about: qa/packet-gate-test.js (review I242): the page count of each form in the simulated full packet (46 forms, the clock held at 2026-10-14), and, under "known", the faults the packet already had when the gate was written: each is printed as KNOWN on every run and fails only when it grows. A count changes only with WS_PRINT_CHANGED (the forms named) or GATE_UPDATE=1 (everything, known faults included).
